insights.concise_text: The BOW+LING model trained on the full Reddit dataset was applied to millions of new unannotated posts to address four research questions.

triple.subject: BOW+LING model trained on the full Reddit dataset
triple.object: millions of new unannotated posts

insights.concise_text: Because middle-quartile dogmatism annotations were unreliable, the classifier used balanced dogmatic and non-dogmatic classes drawn from the top and bottom quartiles.

triple.subject: unreliable middle-quartile dogmatism annotations
triple.object: classifier training on top and bottom quartiles

insights.concise_text: Linguistic features derived from LIWC categories boosted BOW classification AUC to 0.881 within Reddit and 0.791 on held out New York Times comments.

triple.subject: linguistic features derived from LIWC categories
triple.object: BOW classification AUC

insights.concise_text: The claim that linguistic features generalize across new domains is supported by their boost on held out New York Times comments to 0.791 AUC.

triple.subject: held out New York Times comments result of 0.791 AUC
triple.object: linguistic features generalize across new domains

insights.concise_text: The classifier's probability labels were used on 1.6 million posts to find that politics and religion subreddits have the highest dogmatism levels.

triple.subject: classifier probability labels on 1.6 million posts
triple.object: finding politics and religion subreddits have highest dogmatism levels

insights.concise_text: The 1000-user, 10 million-post corpus annotated by the classifier yielded a behavioral model significantly predictive of dogmatism with R^2=0.1.

triple.object: behavioral model significantly predictive of dogmatism with R^2=0.1

insights.concise_text: In 600,000 A1→B→A2 conversation triples, B's dogmatism coefficient was positively associated with A2 dogmatism, supporting the claim that dogmatism brings out dogmatism.

triple.object: one user's dogmatism brings out dogmatism in their conversational partner

insights.concise_text: The finding that dogmatic users post frequently and in specific communities follows from activity and focus being positively associated with dogmatism.

triple.subject: activity and focus positively associated with dogmatism
triple.object: dogmatic users post frequently and in specific communities

insights.concise_text: The first corpus of social media posts annotated with dogmatism scores was built from 5000 Reddit posts labeled by AMT crowdworkers.

triple.object: 5000 Reddit posts labeled by AMT crowdworkers
